FLIGHT MANUAL

01
GRAVITY ANCHOR Press & Hold mouse/touch/spacebar near a node planet to latch on and swing in orbit.
02
SLINGSHT LAUNCH Release button to release from the gravitational beam and shoot forward with accrued momentum. Drop to the bottom edge and you'll bounce back up — only asteroids can destroy you.
03
LIGHT PULSES & COMBOS Collect glowing yellow gems. Skim close to asteroids without crashing to multiply your score combo!
04
LEVELS & POWER-UPS Climb higher to level up: everything gets faster and more crowded, but each level multiplies your points. The background glow shifts colour with every new level. Grab a golden 2X orb for double points, and a pink ♥ for an extra life.
05
GATE PLANETS A gravity wall blocks the end of every level. Fly or swing into the ringed planet beneath it to dive inside a 30-second arcade challenge. Slide your thumb anywhere (phone) or move the mouse (PC) to steer — firing is automatic, tap/click to launch. Survive or win to break the wall and reach the next level; fail and you lose a life.
06
PLASMA OVERCHARGE Keep holding while you orbit to fill the plasma ring around your orb. Release once it glows to fire a sonic burst: a huge speed boost, brief invulnerability, and small asteroids in your path get smashed. A fully charged burst smashes everything.
07
BLACK HOLES & WORMHOLES Black holes bend your flight path towards their core — touching the core costs a life. Anchoring to a node shields you from their pull, so time your release to escape. Cyan wormholes warp you further up the map and grant x2 points for a few seconds.
08
HYPER-DRIVE STREAKS Skim 3 asteroids in quick succession to unleash a neon shockwave that vacuums every nearby Light Pulse straight into your orb. Faster flight and bigger combos make the whole galaxy pulse harder.
09
PILOTS & HYPER-NOVA Your pilot (Lyra by default) calls out the action from the top-right HUD. Fill her MP gauge by grabbing glowing violet MP crystals and skimming asteroids. MP stacks up to three stored charges and, like your hearts, carries into every new level. With a charge ready tap ✦ HYPER-NOVA (or press E) — or just release a max overcharge — to unleash a full-screen sonic burst that smashes asteroids, vacuums every Light Pulse and makes you briefly invulnerable. Unlock Nova, the Solar Ace, in the Shop Matrix.
